record.title: Design a narrowly scoped stock APK admission experiment
record.intent: Identify an auditable guest-only mechanism for admitting the exact stock APK without changing its bytes.
requirements: Confine investigation to disposable research guests and preserve the stock APK and reference corpus.
Preserve baseline evidence; do not silently substitute a newer Android image or different APK.
Reject global signature-check disabling and any changes to physical instrument or host security policy.
acceptance: Identify the pinned guest framework build and the shared-UID admission checks relevant to the observed error.
Inspect available guest debug mechanisms and document the chosen implementation boundary and rollback.
Specify admission matching the exact APK digest, package, signer, and requested shared UID.
Define negative controls for unrelated packages, different signers, and changed APK bytes.
Produce an implementable bounded design, or retain this task open with a concrete feasibility blocker.
